# `adt locks`

List and manage persisted ADT lock handles

```bash
adt locks [options] [command]
```

**Subcommands**

| Command             | Description                                                   |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `adt locks list`    | List all persisted lock entries                               |
| `adt locks cleanup` | Try to UNLOCK every persisted entry on the SAP system         |
| `adt locks clear`   | Remove all entries from the registry (does NOT unlock on SAP) |

## `adt locks list`

List all persisted lock entries

```bash
adt locks list [options]
```

## `adt locks cleanup`

Try to UNLOCK every persisted entry on the SAP system

```bash
adt locks cleanup [options]
```

## `adt locks clear`

Remove all entries from the registry (does NOT unlock on SAP)

```bash
adt locks clear [options]
```

Global options (`--sid`, `--config`, `--verbose`, …) are accepted by every command — see the [command reference index](./index.md#global-options).
